condition_gap.roles: All outputs are single-step noisy-GT BUILD probes; GT CLIP/flow cells are oracle diagnostic only, never deployable QUERY
condition_gap.limitations: No CFG, no free Gaussian generation, no causal proof of multi-step sampling quality. FPS/augmentation/VAE are fixed to QUERY. CLIP uses the same training helper for both pixel sources; this is not an exact public test.py CLIP path. Gray-hole flow is an extra control for the owned/public source difference. Compare metrics within the same sigma; low-noise GT input is not independent reconstruction.

gap_review.architecture_components_diagram: 完整GT或可见首帧 -> CLIP；完整GT/黑洞可见/灰洞可见视频 -> RAFT -> FCNet -> 潜变量传播；共同的可见视频 -> 条件VAE；带噪GT latent + 传播条件 + CLIP -> SVD时序去噪 -> 单步预测
gap_review.assistant_verdict: 18张联系图显示：在sigma=700的同噪声比较中，首帧CLIP从完整GT换为可见黑洞会改变大块颜色与明暗布局，并使洞区误差明显增大；但两者都没有重建可辨认的鸟、翅膀或枝叶细节。在sigma=15.59，各组仍是树影、棕色地面和草带的模糊轮廓，CLIP与三种flow的视觉差距均很小。黑洞、灰洞与GT flow在同CLIP下没有稳定可见的结构排序。sigma=0.002的下排几乎复制上排GT，来自带噪GT输入，不能证明从纯高斯QUERY生成或模型已学会外扩。此审核只判定单步条件响应，不能判定完整25帧时序或正式生成质量。

image_evidence.visual_observation: 全部6组下排只有深绿树影、棕橙色区域与亮绿草带等粗色块。f00侧边出现大片均匀灰褐区；f12/f24仍是模糊色面，没有GT中鸟的头、羽毛或展开翅膀的清晰形状。完整GT CLIP与可见黑洞CLIP的整体色块/暗区分布可见不同；三种flow在固定CLIP下几乎不可从联系图分辨。
image_evidence.same_sigma_metric_check: 固定官方黑洞flow时，完整GT CLIP的hole_mse=0.376662，可见黑洞CLIP=0.431888，差0.055226；固定完整GT CLIP时三种flow的hole_mse范围0.376662至0.377947。数值支持CLIP响应较大，但图像都不具语义结构。

image_evidence.visual_observation: 全部6组出现相似的黑绿树影、棕色模糊主体与横向草带；f00/f12/f24的GT鸟姿态和羽毛未清晰恢复。换CLIP或flow只有轻微明暗与边缘变化，不能把任一flow判为有效结构修复。
image_evidence.same_sigma_metric_check: 固定官方黑洞flow时，完整GT CLIP的hole_mse=0.325827，可见黑洞CLIP=0.327322，差0.001495；固定可见CLIP时三种flow的hole_mse范围0.327322至0.327453。

image_evidence.visual_observation: 全部6组下排在三张抽帧上几乎逐像素复现上排GT，包含鸟体与背景细节；组间差异肉眼不可辨。这里的模型输入含几乎完整的GT latent，故不是未知区域生成证据。
image_evidence.same_sigma_metric_check: 各组hole_mse约3.983e-6；不与高/中sigma直接比较作为生成质量排名。

condition_comparison.clip: 同sigma且flow固定时，高sigma的完整GT oracle CLIP影响明显；中sigma仅轻微；低sigma被近乎完整GT输入淹没。这是单步响应，不证明多步QUERY中CLIP是唯一瓶颈。
condition_comparison.flow: 同sigma且CLIP固定时，完整GT、公开黑洞、owned灰洞flow的三帧联系图没有可辨认的鸟体/边界质量排序；黑洞与灰洞的误差差异远小于高sigma的CLIP差异。不能据此认定flow无用。

gap_review.next_minimal_control: 保持step100权重、25帧输入、官方黑洞可见flow、条件VAE增强噪声、初始纯高斯latent、采样器、CFG与seed完全一致，只切换首帧CLIP为完整GT oracle或可见黑洞各跑一条paper-feedforward QUERY；对比全部25帧native与硬合成。这是诊断条件差异，不允许把oracle当可部署结果；无需训练更新。
limitations: 18张图每张只抽f00/f12/f24；不能从3帧判断完整时序、闪烁或物体运动。

clip_query_review.reviewed_frame_indices: 0..24 in both branches, every frame represented by gt/visible/pred/comp
clip_query_review.architecture_components_diagram: 可见视频 -> 可见RAFT/FCNet/双向传播 + 条件VAE -> SVD时序去噪 -> native预测 -> 与可见中心硬合成；完整GT首帧或可见首帧 -> CLIP -> 同一SVD去噪；两支共享初始高斯、采样器、CFG和其余条件
clip_query_review.assistant_verdict: 完整GT首帧的oracle CLIP没有恢复缺失两侧的场景结构。两支的25帧native预测都以灰、白或蓝灰平滑侧块为主，没有与GT对应的猫头鹰展开翅膀、羽毛、树枝或草地延伸；可见中心在native中也变成过亮棕块或后段黑绿色矩形带。comp中的清晰猫头鹰主要是可见中心被硬贴回，不能归功于生成。oracle与可见CLIP分支有轻微亮度/色调差异，但相同的结构失败和时序突变保留。因此首帧CLIP训练-QUERY差异在这个固定step100/seed/视频上不是单独充分的修复；也不能由一个100步权重和单视频判定模型容量失败。下一步优先做原始SVD标准首帧条件的最小sanity，而不是直接追加训练更新。

full_gt_oracle.role: 只用于诊断，读取隐藏GT，不可部署QUERY
full_gt_oracle.native: f00-16侧区多为均匀灰或白色板，f07和f17附近突变为亮白；f08右侧转蓝灰。f19-24中心漂成黑绿条和过曝土色，侧区大面积白色，未形成GT鸟翼或背景树枝。
full_gt_oracle.composite: 硬贴回的中心保留GT鸟头/身体，但两侧仍为灰白平板，接缝为明显垂直边界；不能把清晰中心算作生成恢复。

visible_black_hole.native: 同样呈现灰白平板、过曝棕色中心与后段黑绿矩形条；缺失区无可辨鸟翼或背景延续。与oracle分支仅见局部色调、亮度和晚段暗带变化，未见结构等级改善。
visible_black_hole.composite: 中心GT硬贴回后视觉上能看出猫头鹰运动，但两侧仍无场景补全，边界突兀。

temporal_evidence: f00-06两支主要是稳定的大灰色侧板，鸟翼的真实伸展未进入生成侧区。
f07-09侧区在亮白与蓝灰之间快速跳变，GT中鸟翼姿态连续变化。
f10-16大灰块返回，中心native的鸟体仍是模糊棕块。
f17-24再转亮白；f19起native中心与可见输入显著偏离，出现深色矩形带，comp通过GT中心硬贴回掩盖此偏离。
clip_query_review.controlled_comparison: diagnostic.json表明两支共享可见黑洞flow、传播、条件VAE、time IDs、25步scheduler、逐帧CFG1到3和完全相同的初始高斯；仅CLIP源不同。因此本次相近的结构失败可用于排除‘只换完整首帧CLIP便能修复这一次QUERY’。不证明CLIP无影响，也不把oracle视为正式质量结果。
clip_query_review.next_minimal_control: 优先用同一原始SVD XT 1.1、当前环境/权重/调度器，在标准img2vid入口给完整真实首帧，生成25帧并看全帧native，作为预训练模型与采样链的sanity；不把它当outpainting成绩。若标准SVD也无法生成有结构的视频，先查权重、scheduler、预处理及数值接线；若标准SVD正常，再定位本地条件接线/短训状态，之后才决定是否给有界训练预算。此建议不包含本次启动作业。
limitations: 仅一个训练片段、一个step100权重和同一初始噪声；不能判定泛化或模型容量极限。

visual_observations.teacher_single_step: At f00/f12/f24 both before and after denoised images show a blurry tan bird-like body against dark foliage and a green grass band. After updates, local foliage and tan/grass boundaries are slightly clearer, but the bird face and wing detail remain substantially smeared compared with GT. Three single-step teacher frames cannot establish 25-frame sampling or temporal fidelity.
visual_observations.query_before_native: Across all 25 frames, the native result contains dark greenery, a horizontal bright grass band and a fuzzy tan bird-like patch near the left-center. It is not just a featureless gray block, but the bird is indistinct, shifted and much less structured than GT; broad textures persist almost unchanged while GT wings open, fold and shift.
visual_observations.query_after_native: Across all 25 frames, native greenery and ground texture become somewhat more detailed and the tan patch is slightly more coherent. The improvement is local appearance on this one trained clip, not a clearly reconstructed bird face or wing geometry. The native subject stays largely in place while GT changes pose, especially f07-f14; later f20-f24 show only weak texture/shape drift instead of matching the bird's settling motion. The visible center is not faithfully preserved within native pred.
visual_observations.composite_and_boundaries: The composite pastes the true time-varying central strip. Its clear bird head, wing motion and center grass are therefore not native model accomplishments. Before and after, the two vertical join lines remain apparent through foliage, bird/body and grass; the generated sides are differently detailed and do not move consistently with the pasted center. After-update detail does not remove these seams.
visual_observations.temporal_jumps: No dominant single-frame global flash is evident in the 25-frame boards. The main temporal defect is a nearly frozen native subject/background and weak response to GT pose changes, not isolated catastrophic flicker.

recorded_teacher_losses_not_formal_quali.interpretation: The fixed teacher objective improved after real updates, consistent with trainability under its privileged noisy-GT and full-GT conditions. This does not show that visible-only pure-noise QUERY learned the motion or generalizes.

next_control.recommendation: On this same clip and fixed query noise, compare correct time-aligned visible-only QUERY conditions with a temporally shuffled or zeroed propagation/conditioning input at the same checkpoint, and compare native side regions frame by frame. Then, only if a controlled optimization is needed, repeat a small fixed-input probe with teacher conditioning built from visible-only data and fps matched to QUERY, keeping GT only in the noisy training target; compare QUERY before/after under identical seed.
next_control.what_it_can_support: The frozen ablation can test whether the current QUERY output depends detectably on the intended temporal conditions. The matched-condition probe can test whether the teacher-to-QUERY conditioning gap limits fixed-clip learning. Neither control by itself establishes validation-set generalization, formal P1 success, or a reason to add an unbounded training budget.

limits: One deliberately reused training clip with fixed noise and 64 diagnostic updates; capacity response here is not a held-out validation result.
Teacher uses privileged GT-derived inputs and a noisy-GT latent, while QUERY uses visible-only conditions and Gaussian initialization.
All 25 before/after QUERY frames were visually inspected in contact boards; no formal quantitative video metric was calculated by this review.

assistant_review.frames_reviewed: normal 和 repeat_first 各自完整 f00–f24，逐个查看 GT/visible/pred/comp 四行
visual_evidence: GT f00–f14 的猫头鹰翅膀明显抬起、折回、再展开，f15–f24 逐渐压低；背景大体固定，主体姿态是主要时序信号。normal 的 pred f00–f24 主要保持模糊的黄褐色主体及左侧暗翼，只有轻微形变/纹理漂移，未按 GT 的翅膀开合与落下同步变化。
repeat_first 的 pred 比 normal 更接近首帧的黄褐主体和横向暗翼，在主体形态、位置/边缘清晰度及树叶草地纹理上均有可见改变；但 f05–f24 仍近乎维持首帧姿态，没有恢复 GT 中后段翅膀运动。因此影响不只是纹理噪声，也不是正确的运动内容。
normal 的 comp 中央可见带随 GT 动，是输入硬写回；带外 pred 仍为模糊且近静止的主体，边界有明显接缝/重影。repeat_first 的 comp 中央由重复首帧写回，不能用它与 normal 的 comp 比较模型生成质量。
assistant_review.verdict: hold：当前控制确认后续可见帧改变会传至融合条件和原生输出，但 normal 原生预测未正确跟随 GT 主体运动；非零数值差异不足以支持放大正式训练预算。

next_control_assessment.proposal: 从同一正式 step500 权重出发，在同一固定训练片段上做最多 64 更新的 teacher 首帧 CLIP 来源 fullGT→visible 单因素控制，保留 fps、flow、VAE、sigma、noise、其他输入与优化设置；用相同 fixed-noise teacher 与 Gaussian QUERY 前后对照。
next_control_assessment.assessment: 可作为有限的训练/QUERY 条件落差诊断，但本次 normal/repeat 共用首帧 CLIP，不能据此把 CLIP 判为当前静止输出的根因。只有 QUERY 中带外主体姿态及逐帧运动改善才算支持该假设；teacher 损失下降或单纯像素差异不足。单片段 64 更新不证明泛化或最终指标，亦不能单独否定更长训练。

assistant_review.limitations: repeat_first 同时改变后续可见 RGB 驱动的 RAFT、条件 VAE 与传播，固定 normal refs，不是标准自动 refs 查询；此图像审查无正式质量或时序指标。

scope_and_checks.source_frames: 00010.jpg through 00130.jpg every five source indices, displayed as f00-f24
scope_and_checks.comparison: The prior fixed_input_capacity_step500_64 branch used full-GT first-frame CLIP in teacher BUILD. This branch used only the visible first-frame pixels for teacher CLIP. Both use the same visible-only QUERY, query seed 2036, 25 sampling steps and the same fixed training clip.
scope_and_checks.cache_comparison: run.json reports plan, flow, target_latent, cond_latent, noise, time_ids, mask, sigma and cond_sigma as exact shared keys; CLIP embedding differs (MAE 0.3090586662). Teacher still uses GT RAFT, noisy-GT BUILD and fps7; QUERY remains visible-only Gaussian and fps6.
scope_and_checks.optimizer_verification: 64 attempted and actual Adam updates, 514 Adam state parameters each advanced by 64, all trainable updates finite, zero formal training updates. This verifies an optimization probe, not a sufficient capacity test.

visual_findings.teacher_contact_only: At f00/f12/f24, both visible-CLIP teacher boards show a blurred tan bird/body, foliage and grass in a single noisy-GT denoising step. After updates the vegetation and body boundary look a little more defined, but face/wing detail remains substantially smeared. The recorded weighted teacher MSE falls from 0.1912105531 to 0.1491708755; this is not evidence of QUERY generation quality or temporal fidelity.
visual_findings.query_before: The visible-CLIP branch starts from the same visually recognizable but poor QUERY baseline as the earlier branch: green grass and dark foliage with a fuzzy tan bird-like patch in native pred, much less articulated than GT.
visual_findings.query_after_native: All f00-f24 frames show more developed grass/foliage texture than the before state and a blurry tan patch suggesting a bird. A face, wings and body outline are still not reliably reconstructed in native pred. GT wing extension and pose change around f07-f14, then settles through f24; the generated patch and background remain largely stationary, with only small local texture changes. There is no evident new motion-following capability from changing the teacher CLIP source.
visual_findings.paired_after_comparison: Direct inspection of each of the five corresponding full-GT-CLIP and visible-CLIP QUERY-after boards shows near-identical scene layout, bird-like blob position, grass bands and weak motion. Small local foliage, brightness and texture differences are visible, but no consistent visible-CLIP advantage in bird structure, time-aligned wings, side-region continuity or overall native coherence. The board files are not byte-identical; this is a visual assessment, not a claim of equal pixels or equal metrics.
visual_findings.composite_boundaries: In both branches comp has a crisp moving bird head and wing in its central vertical strip because GT visible pixels are pasted back. This is not native preservation. The two fixed vertical seams remain apparent in foliage, bird and grass; generated sides have a different structure/texture and do not follow the changing central pose.
visual_findings.temporal_artifacts: No dominant one-frame global flash is apparent in either after sequence. The principal failure is a near-frozen, poorly articulated native bird compared with GT's pose sequence, plus stationary side content against a moving pasted center.

assistant_review.interpretation: Matching only the teacher CLIP pixel source to visible-only inference produces a small appearance perturbation but no clear independent QUERY structure or motion gain over the full-GT-CLIP 64-update branch. This does not establish that CLIP conditioning has no causal role, because GT flow, noisy-GT teacher input and fps differ from QUERY and this fixed-clip probe has only 64 updates.
assistant_review.next_control: If isolating the remaining teacher-to-QUERY condition gap, compare a same-budget fixed-clip branch that changes only teacher flow/propagated conditioning from GT-derived to visible-only while retaining visible first-frame CLIP, then evaluate with the same QUERY seed and all 25 native frames. That comparison could test whether privileged GT flow is the dominant mismatch on this clip; it would not by itself demonstrate generalization or justify an open-ended formal run.
limits: Only one reused training clip and 64 fixed-input updates per branch; not held-out validation and not a sufficient model-capacity bound.
Teacher images contain noisy-GT information and cover only f00/f12/f24, so they do not measure sampled temporal quality.
This review computes no formal metrics and credits no GT pixels pasted into comp as model generation.
